limitations: A single support role and, for configuration, an ADMIN role were tested; no exhaustive role matrix is claimed.
Unknown-field validation was checked only for the specific create and configuration routes listed.
No idempotency-key replay is asserted for these non-idempotency-key CRUD routes; coupon replay evidence is separate.
The staff assignment test only exercises removal of an inactive assignment; it does not exercise adding active staff.
